scripts: Hello there! It's such a lovely day today, isn't it?
So here's how to dress me up:
Just click and drag an item onto me.
If you want to change the color of the item,
If you want my hair back to the way it was, just press A.
If you want my clothing back to the way it was, just press B.
If you want my accessories back to the way it was, just press C.
To change my skin color, press a number.
Now~ dress me up for the Valentine's Date!
